full_prompt_en: A square natural-history-style illustration shows many jellyfish, corals, shells, and other marine forms floating against a nearly black field. The organisms fill the frame from edge to edge but remain separated by thin dark channels. Near the upper center-right, a large amber jellyfish opens like a translucent umbrella; delicate long tentacles descend into the middle of the picture. At the upper left, a blue-green circular organism with a lacy golden center spreads radial folded lobes. A broad coral-pink fan rises from the left middle, its pleated surface lined with fine warm ridges. Smaller bell-shaped jellyfish, branching coral pieces, spiral shells, and orange-gold globes cluster across the lower half. One pale curled form at lower left resembles a floating anemone, while a golden rounded structure near the bottom center bears repeated beadlike protrusions. Hair-thin tendrils and spines connect the larger specimens without turning them into a single solid mass. The forms are carefully outlined and shaded, with transparent amber membranes, matte pink fans, ridged shells, and granular coral each possessing a distinct surface. A warm yellow light seems to shine through the transparent specimens from above and behind, while cooler blue-green edges recede into the black. There is no seabed, horizon, or readable label, so the arrangement reads as a suspended specimen plate rather than a literal underwater view. Despite the density, varied sizes and small gaps keep individual silhouettes discernible. The overall composition is ornate and investigative, using warm coral and gold against cool teal and deep black to celebrate intricate natural geometry.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形自然史风格插画呈现许多水母、珊瑚、贝壳和其他海洋形态，悬浮于近黑色场域。生物从边到边填满画面，彼此仍有细窄深色缝隙。上部中央偏右，一只大型琥珀色水母像半透明伞面打开，纤细长触须垂入画面中部。左上，一个蓝绿色圆形生物展开带蕾丝般金色中心的放射褶叶。宽阔珊瑚粉扇形从左中部升起，打褶表面有细暖色脊线。更小的钟形水母、分枝珊瑚、螺旋贝壳和橙金色圆体聚在下半部。左下一个浅色卷曲形似漂浮海葵，底部中央附近的金色圆体带重复珠粒状突起。发丝般细的触须与尖刺联结较大标本，却不让它们变成一块实体。形体轮廓和阴影都认真描绘，透明琥珀膜、哑光粉色扇面、带脊贝壳与颗粒珊瑚各有不同表面。暖黄光仿佛从上方和后方穿过透明标本，较冷的蓝绿边缘退入黑暗。没有海床、地平线或可读标签，因此安排更像悬空标本图谱，而非字面的水下视角。尽管密集，不同大小和小间隙让每个剪影仍可辨。整体构图华丽而富探索性，以暖珊瑚色和金色对照冷青绿与深黑，展现繁复自然几何。
style_prompt_en: The natural-history illustration combines specimen-level precision with an ornamental, edge-to-edge arrangement. Many shapes vary in scale and radial structure, but narrow dark gaps preserve their individual contours. Warm amber, coral, gold, and rose glow against cool teal and a near-black ground. Translucent membranes, ribbed folds, granular surfaces, and hairlike filaments are differentiated through fine linework and selective shading. Backlit highlights make thin forms luminous, while opaque forms hold softer matte color. The space is shallow and suspended, organized by repeated circular centers, branching lines, and undulating edges rather than a horizon. The overall effect is encyclopedic and fantastical, turning careful anatomical detail into a dense yet readable decorative field.
style_prompt_zh: 这种自然史插画把标本级精确度与从边到边的装饰性安排结合。众多形状在尺度和放射结构上变化，狭窄深色空隙仍保留各自轮廓。暖琥珀、珊瑚、金色和玫瑰色在冷青绿与近黑底前发亮。半透明薄膜、带脊褶面、颗粒表面和发丝状细线通过精细线条与选择性阴影区分。背光高光使薄形体发亮，不透明形体保持更柔的哑光颜色。空间浅而悬浮，由重复圆心、分枝线条和起伏边缘组织，而非地平线。整体效果兼具百科图鉴感与幻想感，把认真解剖细节转成密集却易读的装饰色域。
theme_en: A dense scientific-fantasy arrangement of colorful jellyfish and marine organisms
theme_zh: 一组彩色水母与海洋生物组成的密集科学幻想图谱
name: Ernst Haeckel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
